rule: A domain not listed here is never fetched. A listed domain with enabled:false is skipped and reported as "listed but not enabled". Only tiers with canVerify:true can produce status "verified".

approved.label: Reference works & Church documents
approved.means: The Catholic Encyclopedia and similar reference works, the Holy See's own site, and long-established Catholic/secular reference.

scripture.label: Scripture text (NABRE)
scripture.means: The bishops' NABRE pages. Proves what the biblical TEXT says; not history, dating or interpretation.

primary.label: Primary-text libraries
primary.means: Libraries that reproduce public-domain primary texts (Fathers, council acts, classics) verbatim from named editions.

reference.label: Specialist reference databases
reference.means: Data reference works trusted for ONE kind of fact (e.g. bishops and dioceses). Not for history or miracles.

official.label: Official / institutional sites
official.means: A shrine, order, diocese or government body speaking about itself. Authoritative for its own subject; an interested party.

reported.label: Reported (media and catalogues)
reported.means: Established Catholic media and catalogues. Allowed as a source, but a match is recorded as status 'reported', never 'verified'.

domains.operator: Kevin Knight (private, not a Church body)
domains.why: Hosts the 1907–1914 Catholic Encyclopedia (published with imprimatur), the Church Fathers (Schaff series) and the Summa Theologiae. Stable URLs; the project's first reference by editorial rule.
domains.useFor: Saint lives, councils, doctrine history, patristic and Thomistic texts.
domains.limits: Pre-1914 scholarship: dates and historical-critical questions are sometimes outdated. Privately run.

domains.why: The Church's own publication of papal and conciliar documents, the Catechism, and Vatican II. The primary source for magisterial text.
domains.useFor: Encyclicals, council documents, Catechism, canonization decrees, papal addresses.
domains.limits: Some pages are translations; no historical commentary. Archive pages may be reorganized.

domains.operator: United States Conference of Catholic Bishops

domains.limits: Proves the text only. Psalm numbering is Hebrew, not Vulgate. Copyrighted: link out freely, but ask USCCB before showing the text in-app. The Lectionary wording of some OT passages may differ from the 2010 NABRE.
domains.vetted: verified in an earlier session (Luke 1 read in full); link pattern for other books not individually checked
